tagline: Down into the James, a river flat enough to run backward.
intro: South of Highway 46 the backway drops into the James River valley and follows it down through LaMoure County, by Adrian, Dickey, Grand Rapids and LaMoure, to the county line. The river winds below through tall grass prairie and wildflowers, in country known for its earthen mounds and early settlement.
The James falls only about five inches to the mile. When its tributaries run high, its water has been known to flow upstream for several miles.

moments.title: Grand Rapids
moments.text: A post office from 1880 to 1966, named for the rapids in the James River.

moments.title: LaMoure
moments.text: A James River town founded in 1882, with a 1907 courthouse under a metal-clad dome ringed in bull's-eye windows.
